This guide will empower you to accept Bitcoin seamlessly, eliminating platform fees and retaining more of your earnings. By using the right [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-bitcoin-payments-digital-downloads-stripe-2|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]], you can set up a robust digital commerce stack that ensures you own everything and operate independently.

content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Traditional payment platforms impose heavy fees that cut into your profits, with Gumroad charging 10% on every sale. In contrast, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, meaning you can save significant amounts. For instance, if you sell 100 ebooks at $97 each, you retain an additional $921. This financial advantage, combined with the sovereignty of owning your infrastructure, allows you to operate without dependency on external platforms that may restrict access.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, you need a few essential components: a domain name for branding, a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your store, and backend services like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for processing orders. Additionally, set up a storage solution using Supabase or Google Sheets to manage orders and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Lastly, integrate NOWPayments for Bitcoin processing. Each of these components is free or low-cost, ensuring a minimal upfront investment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your NOWPayments account to accept Bitcoin. Create a product listing for your ebooks, specifying details like the title, price, and delivery method. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate the delivery of your ebooks upon payment confirmation. This setup ensures that your customers receive their products instantly after making a purchase, enhancing their experience and reducing manual workload.
NOWPayments enables you to keep 99.5% of your earnings from Bitcoin sales.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Share your store link with your audience and start promoting your ebooks. Monitor your sales through Supabase or Google Sheets, and ensure that your delivery automation is functioning correctly. After your first transaction, evaluate the process to identify any improvements. This will help you refine your system for efficiency and enhance customer satisfaction.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After establishing a smooth operation, focus on scaling. Add more products to your store and explore marketing strategies to reach a wider audience. Leverage social media and online communities to promote your ebooks. Consider bundling products for higher-value sales. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides additional blueprints and templates to streamline further expansion, ensuring your infrastructure can support increased traffic and sales.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using NOWPayments for Bitcoin transactions. This allows you to bypass conventional payment platforms entirely while retaining a larger portion of your earnings. With a proper setup, such as using GitHub Pages for hosting and Cloudflare Workers for delivery automation, you can establish a fully operational store with minimal fees.
Own your infrastructure completely with no reliance on external platforms.

If you're exploring ways to sell ebooks and other digital products without the constraints of traditional platforms, check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It includes all necessary blueprints and templates to deploy a powerful sovereign commerce stack. For more details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I accept Bitcoin for my ebook sales?

To accept Bitcoin, set up an account with NOWPayments. Integrate it into your store setup, and ensure your products are properly listed for Bitcoin transactions. This allows you to bypass traditional payment processors.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% on every transaction. This is significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%, allowing you to retain more of your earnings.
Can I automate the delivery of my ebooks?
Yes, you can use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate the delivery of your ebooks. This ensures that customers receive their products instantly after payment confirmation.
What if I want to sell multiple digital products?
Your setup can easily accommodate multiple products. Simply add additional product listings in your NOWPayments account and ensure your delivery automation can handle each product type.
How can I scale my ebook sales once established?
To scale, consider adding more products, bundling items, and enhancing your marketing strategies. Use the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for additional resources to optimize and expand your store.
